label_notes: KNOWN HARNESS LIMITATION, spec-derived and documented, not fabricated: l1_policy.evaluate_l1_malicious_eligibility()'s not_already_processed gate reads idempotency.get_tier_decision(), but replay_harness._simulate_case() NEVER calls whatever records a tier decision (recording is explicitly deferred to the live caller, per l1_policy.py's own docstring) — so within a single run_policy_replay() call, this gate can never actually be observed failing, regardless of how the fixture is built. This case documents the INTENDED outcome per the gate's written contract; a live replay of it today would show predicted_tier=L1 (a documented mismatch, not a passing result) until the harness is extended to simulate idempotency-store state across a batch — out of scope for this phase (dataset preparation only, no harness changes).
